section_summary.extract_value: This Discussion section presents findings from a single study examining body appreciation (measured by the BAS) among Black college women in the United States. The study found that body appreciation had a moderate negative relation with BMI and was associated with reduced eating disorder risk factors, with ethnic identity playing a protective role. The authors acknowledge limitations including reliance on self-reported height and weight, use of a college sample, and note the need for future longitudinal research to clarify temporal relationships.
